info.title: CallTelemetry CUCM Emulator API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI description for the CallTelemetry CUCM emulator JSON orchestration API plus SOAP/XML AXL, RIS, DIME log collection, CDR-on-demand, and PerfMon entrypoints.

post.description: Accepts AXL SOAP operations such as getPhone, getUser, listPhone, and executeSQLQuery.

200.description: SOAP response for the requested AXL operation.

post.description: Accepts RIS SOAP operations such as selectCmDevice and selectCmDeviceExt.

200.description: SOAP response for the requested RIS operation.

post.description: Accepts CUCM serviceability log-collection operations such as listNodeServiceLogs and selectLogFiles.

200.description: SOAP response for the requested DIME log collection operation.

post.description: Returns CUCM serviceability files through multipart/related DIME responses.

200.description: Multipart response containing a SOAP envelope and file payload.

post.description: Accepts get_file_list requests for virtual CDR repository files.

200.description: SOAP response containing matching CDR repository files.

post.description: Accepts CUCM PerfMon operations including counter discovery, collection, and session workflows.

200.description: SOAP response for the requested PerfMon operation.
